title: One «No» a day
line: Five days of truth by subtraction.
intro: Athena teaches that truth is reached by subtraction (ἀφαίρεσις): you need to acquire nothing, because the soul already carries what it seeks; you only remove what covers it. Every subtraction is a «No», said first within. For five days you say one «No» a day to an old state or passion that tosses you about.
does: Say one «No» within each day, to an old state or passion, for five days.
trains: Finding truth by removing what covers it, not by adding more.
each: In the morning, name one old state or passion that tosses you about: irritation, worry, the urge to check the phone, the need to please. When it rises during the day, say «No» to it within, quietly and firmly, and do not replace it with anything: only remove.
note: What did you say «No» to today, and what was left once it had gone?
end: Looking at your five «No»s, what did removing them uncover? And what «Yes» could you plant in the space one of them left?
